about: Test vectors of HJViewer's signed version policy (build/minver/trust-rules/spec.md, 1.6.0). README.md explains the fields. Made by generate.py from the model (model.py); checked by generate.py --check and by tools/hjv-release/tests/vectors.rs.

test_keys.name: root-101
test_keys.about: root key 101 of the vectors (seed a0 a1 .. bf)

test_keys.name: root-102
test_keys.about: root key 102 of the vectors (seed e0 e1 .. ff)

test_keys.name: signing-3
test_keys.about: a signing key no vector build trusts (seed c0 c1 .. df)

test_keys.name: root-103
test_keys.about: a root key no vector build trusts (seed 10 11 .. 2f)

covers.about: COVERS(new, old) of spec 2-3 for every pair of 16 entries

key_file_example.made_by: the age crate 0.11.5 (scrypt work factor 10), not by this tool

research_vector.note: the first draft of the format (build/minver/policy-distribution): the signature is good for signing key 1, the policy text has no epoch and is refused as a policy

cases.name: e1-s1
cases.why: the first policy, by signing key 1: 1.6.0 is out, nothing is enforced
